text:
maria: heads up — I just saw a regular PM (non-admin) hit /admin/usage and they could see per-customer cost/usage breakdowns. not sure if this is UI-only or an auth check slip. cc @jin @alex

alex: ugh. can you repro with a normal user token? also which route exactly?

maria: yep repro steps: curl with jane's session token. route is GET /api/admin/usage?window=30d

maria: sample curl:
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $JANE_TOKEN\" \"https://console.redwood.com/api/admin/usage?window=30d\"
```

maria: response included `cost_breakdown` and `per_route_tokens` fields. not masked.

jin: that sounds like the RBAC role->capability mapping from yesterday's refactor. i switched the old is_admin flag check to has_role('billing_admin') in auth-service, but the role sync job writes role_ids; if role_ids are missing for some users the new check might treat them as "admin?" depending on the feature flag fallback.

alex: which commit? link?

jin: commit 9f3b2a — changed permission evaluation to prefer role lookup. i left a fallback that used to be `is_admin == true` but i mis-ordered the checks so missing role entries default to permissive. my bad.

samir: could KMS rotation have affected the role-sync cron that reads service account secrets? if the sync failed it might have written empty roles for many users.

maria: logs show role-sync ran at 02:15 and returned 200 but payload empty for ~120 users. i saw an error earlier about decrypting the DB credentials around 02:12.

sec-bot: alert: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILURE on secrets-manager for project-infra at 2026-04-07T02:12:13Z (investigate)

alex: so two issues converging: (1) role-sync wrote empty role_ids because it couldn't decrypt db creds after KMS rotation; (2) new permission eval has a permissive fallback when role data is absent.

jin: plan: patch auth-service to make missing role data default to deny for admin-scoped endpoints and add explicit feature-flag guarded fallback. i'll open PR and hotfix.

samir: immediate mitigation: revoke the UI route for /api/admin/usage via gateway rule OR put an authz check high in the middleware to short-circuit until patch. i can flip gateway in 10m.

maria: please do gateway block. we should also rotate any tokens that might have been issued with elevated access.

alex: set incident and page oncall. this is sensitive exposure (cost data). create INC and notify legal/ps.

maria: created INC-2026-0450 (sec-exposure-usage-view). adding links to logs and repro.

jin: PR to patch ready in draft: change default for missing role -> deny, add stricter unit & integration tests, log an audit event when role lookup fails. will request urgent review.

maria: after patch we need to run a migration to re-sync roles for all users and re-run the audit to identify who saw data. samir can you produce a list of tokens used to fetch that endpoint in the window 02:12-02:30?

samir: yes. running query against edge logs: `select user, token_id, path from access_logs where path like \"%/api/admin/usage%\" and ts between '2026-04-07T02:10' and '2026-04-07T02:40'`

samir: found 137 calls from 42 distinct user_ids; 6 were non-admins. extracting token metadata now.

maria: tagging affected customers so CS has a heads-up. legal wants scope of exposure and whether any PII was included (it was cost/usage only).

alex: postmortem actions: 1) revert permissive fallback (jin). 2) add synthetic test hitting /api/admin/usage with non-admin token in CI (maria). 3) make role-sync fail closed if KMS decrypt fails (samir). 4) add high-cardinality audit event for any request that returns `cost_breakdown` (jin). 5) run full audit on access_logs to find exports (maria).

jin: PR merged and hotpatch deployed to auth-service at 1762001500. middleware now denies when roles missing. added 1 failing unit test to ensure missing roles -> 403.

samir: gateway rule applied at 1762001400 to block /api/admin/usage for non-admin until patch. rule removed after hotpatch.

maria: re-run repro with jane token -> now 403.

maria: audit query shows the 6 non-admin users got data before 1762001400. prepping customer notif draft.

alex: do we need to rotate KMS keys again? or just re-run the decrypt migration and re-sync?

samir: ops rotated keys as scheduled which triggered the temporary decrypt failures. we should fix secret-manager retry + alerting and make sync job more tolerant but still fail closed. no full key rotation needed now.

maria: filing follow-up tickets for: (A) CI synthetic test, (B) role-sync fail-closed + better alerting, (C) audit retention for cost access events, (D) customer notification template.

sec-bot: incident INC-2026-0450 status changed -> mitigated at 1762001888. root cause: KMS rotation + permissive fallback in new RBAC eval.

alex: nice work. make sure we capture timeline in postmortem and include sample queries used for audit (ops + legal will want those).

maria: will write postmortem draft and ping for reviews

jin: sorry for the bug, will add a checklist to the RBAC refactor PR next time :thumbsup:

maria: closing thread once postmortem posted and customer notif sent.
